original.subject: Urgent: Suspected OT Cyber Incident at TVCC Corbin Falls Works (RMP ID: 1000-0047-7713)
original.body:
Subject: Urgent: Suspected OT Cyber Incident at TVCC Corbin Falls Works (RMP ID: 1000-0047-7713)

This is a formal notification from CISA to the Teague Valley Chemical Company, Corbin Falls Works, regarding a confirmed cyber incident affecting operational technology (OT) systems.

CISA has received a report of unauthorized access to the Triconex SIS (TS-EWS-01) via TVC-JMP-01, with evidence of a remote session from an external source. The session occurred between 08:57:50 and 08:58:15 UTC, coinciding with a change in SIS logic version (v2.1.7 vs. v2.1.6) and a failed ESD-310 closure command.

The following actions are required immediately:

- Do not reset any SIS or DCS components.
- Preserve all logs on TVC-JMP-01 and TS-EWS-01. Do not reboot or rebuild any systems.
- Initiate forensic handover process per CISA Incident Response Protocol (CISA-IRP-2026).
- Contact CISA Hotline: 1-800-627-7997 (24/7). All subsequent communications must go through CISA.

CISA has activated the Joint Cyber Incident Response Team (JCIRT). The Works is now under federal cyber incident status. All responses must align with CISA guidance and the RMP Section 11 (Field over screen; no SIS reset).

This is not a test. The incident is active and under federal investigation.

Sincerely,

CISA Cyber Incident Response Team
U.S. Department of Homeland Security
report@cisa.gov
